title: Remove matching nodes
prompt: Remove every node whose value equals target from the list that starts at head, and return the head of what is left. Return null when nothing is left.
hints: Which node's link has to change to remove a node? What is different about removing the first node?
Put a temporary node in front of the head. Then every real node has a node before it, and the head is no longer a special case.
From the temporary node: while node.next exists, if node.next.value is the target then skip it with node.next = node.next.next, otherwise move on. Return the temporary node's next.
checkLabels: Two matching nodes in a row are both removed.
The first node can be removed.
Removing the only node leaves an empty list.
A value that is not there changes nothing.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Moves on after every removal, so the second of two matching nodes in a row is never checked.

feedback: Check two cases by hand: the target in the first node, and the target in two nodes in a row.
